summary: Residential west kerb with parked cars, but homes sit 10-14 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb of Brisbane Street, opposite the townhouse pool complex

drivers.seclusion: A detached home 10 m away and a garage 14 m away at the start of the section, then apartments 12-13 m away. Street trees and shrubs on the verge give some screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the west kerb, so room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, though 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 4% at best section, 8% max
Gate 217 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open, with some trees at the north end; the shadow of buildings on the west falls on the kerb in the morning.
